messages:
emma_sales: Hey @nick_infra @sam_engineering — Acme's demo is tomorrow 11:00 PT. They want a sustained burst for an hour of heavy concurrent requests. Can we temporarily increase the Dedicated pool burst and change the drain/scale-down behavior so we can resize without dropping live requests? :pray: 

nick_infra: Got it. Which pool ID and what numbers are you thinking? Also need the exact demo window so we can set an automatic rollback.

emma_sales: Pool ID is pool-ACME-POC-01. Request: burst multiplier x3 for 4h starting 2026-03-22T18:00Z (that covers their 11:00 PT demo + buffer). Set scaleDownCooldown to 10m (600s) and enable graceful drain so in-flight tokens finish. We'll bill via the PO, need a temp burst credit allocation.

sam_engineering: Quick clarifying Qs — does the client expect lower latency or just higher throughput? This affects target instance count.

emma_sales: Throughput + concurrency. They run many short chat completions (avg 60 tokens) but concurrent ~120 sessions during the demo.

nick_infra: Ok. Proposed changes: bump autoscale.max_instances  from 10 -> 30 (burst), set burst.multiplier=3, burst.window=4h, scaleDown.cooldown=600, gracefulDrain=true. I can apply a timed change and auto-revert after 4h. Any objections?

jules_ae: No objections from sales. Please proceed; confirm costs after. I'll sign off on temporary credits.

nick_infra: Will do. Applying config now. Command I used (internal CLI):

```
rwctl dedicated update-pool \
  --pool-id pool-ACME-POC-01 \
  --max-instances 30 \
  --burst-multiplier 3 \
  --burst-duration 4h \
  --scale-down-cooldown 600 \
  --graceful-drain true \
  --rollback-time 2026-03-22T22:00Z
```

nick_infra: Also set a 5-minute pre-demo warm-up that keeps an extra 5 instances live 10m before start.

sam_engineering: How does graceful drain behave? Will it accept new connections during scaling-down?

nick_infra: Graceful drain semantics: on scale-down we stop accepting new long-poll requests on scaled-down nodes, finish KB/KV caches and let in-flight tokens complete, then terminate. For short completions this keeps error rate near 0.

emma_sales: Perfect. Jules — can you confirm the temporary burst credits?

jules_ae: Approving now, I'll route through finance. Expect email confirmation in ~30m.

deploy-bot: action:pool.update success — pool=pool-ACME-POC-01 user=nick_infra ts=1817004460 details="max_instances=30 burst_multiplier=3 burst_duration=4h cooldown=600 graceful_drain=true rollback=2026-03-22T22:00Z"

nick_infra: Changes applied and verified. Autoscaler reported target=28 during a quick synthetic load test (120 concurrent sessions). No errors surfaced.

sam_engineering: Thanks — I'll add a short runbook note: if errors >1% during demo, fall back to hosted API key route and use canary routing to reduce load.

emma_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll update Acme and share demo access. Please hold until confirm rollback after 22:00Z. :thumbsup:

nick_infra: Noted. I'll monitor logs during the window and ping here if anything odd shows up.

deploy-bot: reminder: scheduled rollback for pool=pool-ACME-POC-01 at 2026-03-22T22:00Z (automated).
